title: Surreal Dragon Caduceus Scene
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large blue dragon coiled around a golden caduceus atop a floating blue platform in a starry night sky. Below, a winged muscular figure in a white robe stands beside a shirtless man, while a crowned grey creature in a purple ruff observes from the right near a castle, windmill, circus tent, and pond with a dark shadow silhouette.
prompt: Highly detailed surreal fantasy scene featuring a massive blue dragon with red accents coiled around a large golden caduceus staff, standing on a floating circular blue platform in a dark starry sky with purple spiral patterns and constellation diagrams. On the platform a shirtless muscular man with blue wings stands next to a robed figure with white wings. In the foreground a grey dog-like creature wearing a golden crown and large purple ruff collar stands on the right. Below is a yellow landscape with a blue pond containing a dark human-like shadow silhouette, pink lotus flowers, a medieval castle on the left mountain, a red and yellow circus tent, and a windmill. A yellow moon is visible in the sky. Intricate symbolic composition with mystical elements.
